name: Full value-repair executor interruption and cursor gate
scope: Engineering only; not efficacy or full-training convergence
interruption: Stop with expected exit75 after third immutable frame receipt but before publishing that checkpoint; restart a fresh process from the committed prior slot and require exact orphan replay.
must_pass: Controlled interruption leaves one orphan receipt
Fresh-process restart reproduces all scientific frame receipts and final complete optimizer/RNG/adapter state
Sequence cursor reaches the terminal schedule
Exclusive lock, corrupt checkpoint, journal and cursor unit checks
coverage_limit: This fixed two-video one-epoch real-frame fixture verifies the same executor. Full-capacity attention and teacher association are separately verified by the 28,672-token and autoregressive query8-10 gates. Three-epoch cursor transitions are additionally unit tested. Full-cohort safety remains checked per frame during the actual run.
